label: early-position input of w (or u/v after a late-alphabet letter) in the original phase
predicate: (phase == 0) & (t <= 3) & isin(in_tok, [tok("u"), tok("v"), tok("w")]) & ((in_tok == tok("w")) | isin(prev_tok, [tok("u"), tok("v"), tok("w"), tok("x"), tok("n"), tok("d")]))
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.6% of mass), at early positions (t=0..3 hold ~93% of mass; rare after t=5), and only when the input is w (68% of mass), u (24%) or v (7%); d/n give trace activity. Never fires on <DEL> and almost never in the copy phase. w at t=0 always fires at a fixed ~0.12 of max; for w later the firing rate drops with position (61% at t=1, 45% at t=2, 32% at t=3). The strongest activations are w right after v or w (e.g. v w, w w runs), and u/v fire mainly when the previous token is u/v/w (or x/n/d). The predicate captures ~87% of activation mass on dev, but precision is ~0.59: many early w inputs with other preceding letters stay below threshold, so the exact dependence on the prefix is not fully captured.
